description_en: Updates a failover test job for Express Connect by calling the UpdateFailoverTestJob operation
description_zh: 调用UpdateFailoverTestJob接口更新高速通道故障演练任务
kebab_example: aliyun vpc update-failover-test-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --job-id ftj-bp1yh6mvi13aq3g8w0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateFailoverTestJob

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the failover test job. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
故障演练任务所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The name of the failover test job.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
故障演练任务的名称。

长度为0～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the failover test job.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
故障演练任务的描述信息。

长度为0～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The list of failover test resource IDs. You can add up to 16 resources
parameters.help_zh: 故障演练资源ID列表。最多可以添加16个资源
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The duration of the failover test job. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 1 to 4320
parameters.help_zh: 故障演练任务时长。单位为分钟，取值范围为：1~4320
parameters.name: job_duration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the failover test job
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: sends a request without updating the failover test node. The system checks the request for potential issues, including whether the AccessKey pair is valid, the authorization status of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and whether the required parameters are specified. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.                             
false (default): sends a Normal request, and the failover test node is updated after the check passes. A 2xx HTTP status code is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值范围：

true：发送请求，不会更新故障演练任务。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码DryRunOperation。                             
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并直接更新故障演练任务
parameters.name: dry_run
